title: A closed subset of a quasi-compact space is quasi-compact
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact topological space (every open covering of $X$ has a finite subcovering) and $E\subseteq X$ a closed subset. Then $E$ is quasi-compact in the induced topology: every covering of $E$ by subsets open in $E$ has a finite subcovering.
